name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-07-04, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
